payload.title: Test target-VPS Retina/Qwen visual seeds as UnifiedDB EAP ActiveAssembly anchors with Frank experience dose-response
payload.work_clay: Build a matched H1/proxy differential on the final Frank v0.1 target VPS connecting provenance-bound visual fixtures/ingress to the existing UnifiedDB Emergent Assembly Preprocessor. Produce PerceptualMemorySeed receipts from known/unknown/wrong/stale visual states, resolve only admissible current UnifiedDB refs, compile bounded EAP ActiveAssemblies, then compare QWEN_ONLY, QWEN_PLUS_DIRECT_EXACT_FTS_MEMORY, PAR_RAW_QWEN_SEED, PAR_PROJECTED_QWEN_SEED and EAP-guided active-sensing variants. The experiment MUST independently manipulate Frank-specific target-relevant prior experience rather than treating familiarity as a binary label: run N={0,1,2,4,8,16,32,64} independent provenance-bound Frank episodes by default, extend geometrically if the effect is still rising, hold Qwen pretrained knowledge/model/runtime constant, and report N_onset, N_robust, N_90, N_harm plus the complete outcome/cost curve. One experience point is one independent observed episode with visual/context evidence and verified outcome; repeated frames from the same episode do not inflate N. Run exact-recurrence, state-variant, relational-transfer, novel-entity, conflicting-experience and irrelevant SHAM_N regimes where fixtures permit. Treat visual source and Frank compute host as separate identities: frozen files can isolate the on-VPS mechanism; live remote screen/camera/browser streams require authenticated provenance-bound ingress and separate transport timing. Measure the complete source->ingress->seed->EAP->prompt->correct decision/action path and report both transport-inclusive and on-VPS-only latency. Explicitly inject wrong high-confidence seeds, shuffled graph, stale epoch/hash, similar-looking changed identities, contradictory edges and unknown near-neighbors. Retrieved memory remains context-only and must never override current sensor evidence or mint GWT/effect authority.
payload.reason_clay: Existing UnifiedDB/EAP code already compiles epoch/hash-bound bounded ActiveAssemblies from seed refs and reports microsecond-class subpaths in synthetic tests. Q23 researches whether native Qwen/MVC visual perception can supply those seeds before full semantic decode, creating a low-overhead associative memory reflex. The project owner has now made the Hostinger VPS the final v0.1 target, so only target-VPS end-to-end rows can decide whether EAP is operationally negligible relative to Qwen and whether co-resident UnifiedDB/EAP is a real architectural win. The user additionally requires a causal separation between Frank having no relevant experience and Frank having increasing amounts of prior experience. Without a dose-response factorial, an apparent PAR gain could be Qwen pretrained knowledge, generic extra context, cache warming, exact-recurrence overfit or a single lucky memory. The strongest counterrisks remain confirmation bias, hidden sensor-transport cost and non-monotonic harm from stale/conflicting experience.
payload.completion_clay: A reproducible target-VPS report with raw rows gives sensor-ingress latency when live, on-VPS seed-resolution cost, EAP-only cost, sensor-to-ActiveAssembly and sensor-to-decision p50/p95/p99, text/visual token cost, task/action correctness, memory precision/recall, false-familiarity, wrong-memory acceptance, sensor-override failures, false GWT ignition, service crash/restart/replay and resource shadows. It MUST include the full Frank-experience dose-response curve for matched QWEN_ONLY, DIRECT_MEMORY_N, PAR_EAP_N, PAR_ACTIVE_N and irrelevant SHAM_N lanes; report N_onset, N_robust, N_90 and N_harm or explicitly N_onset > max_tested_N; and separate exact recurrence from state-variant/relational-transfer/novel/conflicting experience. It must show whether PAR beats both QWEN_ONLY and the simpler direct-memory baseline at the same N and whether wrong-seed/shuffled/stale controls collapse the benefit. Target-VPS rows are final-target architecture evidence but do not by themselves grant H1/H2/H3 release credit. Disposition: SUPPORTED, REVISE, REFUTED or NO_CHANGE.
payload.executor_policy: Primary correctness/performance evidence must run on the current Hostinger target VPS. Use existing q23/QNDRF visual fixtures and current EAP implementation where possible to avoid duplicate harness work. Experience dose must use independent provenance-bound episodes and held-out evaluation; Qwen pretrained knowledge is constant and never counted as Frank experience. For live sensors, separate source/transport delay from target-VPS perception/retrieval/reasoning. Do not call the path latency-free; report measured end-to-end and on-VPS latency. Do not wait for a planned GPU/storage VPS unless the owner explicitly changes target or target-VPS measurements prove a blocking requirement. No paid training.
invalidators: Project owner explicitly changes the final Frank v0.1 target host
A newer executed target-VPS receipt already measures the same visual-seed EAP differential including experience dose-response on current artifacts
Current Frank visual path can no longer produce stable evidence-bound entity/state seeds
